chatCompletion.message: Upstream request failed: An active OpenCode Go subscription is required to use Go models.

interpretation: The endpoint and key are accepted for model discovery, but the upstream account has no active OpenCode Go subscription. This is an external entitlement blocker, not a schema or endpoint bug. No model output was fabricated. Offline OpenCode subagents were used for the two Phase 16 packs and are identified separately in their provenance.
